journey.name: Class recording
journey.description: A Polar Verity Sense paired in Settings records a class on its own memory while the phone is in the bag; synced after, the class is logged and opens with its rounds. Needs a real phone on Android 12 or later with Bluetooth on and the sensor charged, switched on and worn: the emulator has no Bluetooth, so this one is run by hand, not on amper-37. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On the welcome, which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip to Set up", then "Skip for now" on "Set up"
Tap the gear on "Today" and scroll to "Heart-rate sensor"
Verify that its row reads "Pair a sensor" over "A Polar Verity Sense or H10, switched on (an H10 worn) and close by"
Tap "Pair a sensor" and allow "Nearby devices" when Android asks

With a second Polar sensor awake nearby (an H10 worn beside a Verity Sense): verify that a sheet asks "Which sensor?" with both names, the nearest first, and tap the one meant; with only one, no sheet shows
Verify that the row reads "Looking for it…", then the sensor's name ("Polar Sense" and its id) over "Paired. Record a class from Today on its day. Tap to forget it"
Go back to "Today", tap "Plan your week", add "BJJ" from "Sport" on today's weekday row, and tap "Back"
Verify that under the day's card a card reads "Record the class" with the sensor's name and a "Record class" button
Tap "Record class"

Verify that the button reads "Reaching the sensor…" for a few seconds, then a notice says "Recording. The phone can go in the bag." and the card reads "Recording since" and the time, with "Sync class"
Close the app, put the phone away, and train for at least fifteen minutes with two hard efforts of three minutes or more and a rest between
Open the app with the sensor still on the arm
Verify that "Today" still shows "Recording since" and the time it was started
Tap "Sync class"

Verify that the "Log" tab opens on a page titled "BJJ class" with today and the time the recording started, a "Length" close to how long it ran, a line of the heart rate with a shaded band a round, "Avg heart rate" and "Peak heart rate", and under "Rounds" a row a round reading its length, "avg", "peak" and "down … in 60 s" or "in 30 s"
Tap "Back"
Verify that the log lists "BJJ class" under today reading its rounds and length ("2 rounds · 21:40"), and the week card's "Sport days" row reads "1 of 1"
Tap the "Today" tab
Verify that the card says "Done for today" with "BJJ class" ticked and no sensor card shows
Tap the "Log" tab, open the "BJJ class" row, tap "More options", "Delete recording", then "Delete"
Verify that a notice says "Recording deleted" and the "BJJ class" row reads "Logged" with an "×"
Switch the sensor off, plan nothing more, and on a day with a class still to log tap "Record class"
Verify that after a while a notice says "Couldn’t find the sensor. Wake it (wear an H10) and keep it close." and the card still offers "Record class"
